Target

class Target(r, settings, move_speed=1)[source]

Bases: object

Target (star) in the game.

Subclasses change only the image, the size and the kill result (see Obstacle).

Parameters:
rint | None

Lane index (0, 1 or 2). If None (or out of range), chosen at random.

settingsGameSettings

Game configuration (injected).

move_speedint, optional

Speed used by move() (set by the current level, in GameController). Defaults to 1.

Attributes:
COLLIDED_RESULTtuple[int, EventType], class attribute

(points, event) when it collides: (10, COLLIDED_TARGET).

AVOIDED_RESULTtuple[int, EventType], class attribute

(points, event) when it is avoided: (0, AVOIDED_TARGET).

MOVE_PATTERNdict[int, tuple[int, int, int]], class attribute

By speed: (lateral move step, growth step, lateral offset). Used by move().

settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

move_speedint

Speed used by move().

sizetuple[int, int]

Current size (grows as the object approaches).

rectpygame.Rect

Hitbox/position on screen.

imageslist[pygame.Surface]

Animation frames.

current_frameint

Index of the frame being shown.

current_postuple

Current position.

current_roadint

Lane of the object (0 left, 1 middle, 2 right).

animation_timerfloat

Time of the next frame change.

lineLine | None

Road line the object is attached to.

prev_pos_yfloat

Height in the previous frame, set by update_current_pos (used by reached).

Methods

animate

Advance the animation frame when its time has come.

define_spawn_pos(r=None)[source]

Define the lane and initial position of the object.

Parameters:
rint | None, optional

Desired lane (0 left, 1 middle, 2 right); random if None or out of range.

Returns:
tuple

(road, start_pos), with start_pos from GameSettings.OBJ_POS.

define_pos(x, y)[source]

Move the object rectangle to the projected coordinates.

Parameters:
x, yfloat

Projected position; the current rect size is kept.

move()[source]

Move the object down with a small lateral drift.

The drift depends on the lane and on the current speed (MOVE_PATTERN); speeds outside the table use a default pattern.

move_to(x, y)[source]

Move the object directly to a given position.

Parameters:
x, yfloat

New position; the rect is moved by the same offset.

update_current_pos(x, y)[source]

Update the current position directly (used by Background).

Keeps the height of the previous frame to detect the passage in front of the car (see reached).

Parameters:
x, yfloat

New position.

reached(line_y)[source]

Check whether the object base crossed line_y this frame.

Parameters:
line_yfloat

Screen y to test (front of the car).

Returns:
bool

True if the previous height was above line_y and the current one is at or below it.

Notes

Compares with the previous frame, so the passage is detected even when the road advances several segments at once (low FPS).

animate()[source]

Advance the animation frame when its time has come.

draw_hitbox(surface)[source]

Draw the object hitbox (when enabled).

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on.

draw(surface)[source]

Draw the object on screen, animated.

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on. The hitbox is drawn too when DRAW_HITBOX is on.

kill(targets, collided)[source]

Remove the object from the list and return the result.

Does not play sounds or draw: GameController hands the result to FeedbackView.

Parameters:
targetslist

Active objects (the object is removed from it).

collidedbool

True when it collided with the car; False when it left the screen without colliding.

Returns:
KillResult

Points, event and lane. Target: 10 when collided, 0 when avoided.
